model.name: R19.86: URL/webitem files clicked in room must open the ContentPreviewer drawer — regression fix.
model.description: REGRESSION (~862868bfe): clicking a URL/webitem file item in the in-room file tree no longer opens the ContentPreviewer/detail drawer. Previously worked (R19.73/77). FIX: restore the file-click → drawer-open path for url-type FileUnits. The click handler or event delegation for url/webitem items must invoke the same ContentPreviewer path as image/html files.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "URL files do NOT open the drawer anymore."
model.crossRefNote: R19.73 (in-room preview) and R19.77 (URL preview two buttons) both depend on the click→drawer path that regressed. R19.86 restores it.
